input.headline: High school chemistry teacher moving into instructional design
input.about: I've taught chemistry at Lakeview High School for eight years. I write most of my own lab materials and I redesigned our intro unit around short videos and practice quizzes. Last year I completed a certificate in instructional design and built two self-paced modules in Articulate Rise. I'm looking for instructional design roles in higher ed or corporate learning.

goldFacts: I have taught chemistry at Lakeview High School for eight years.
I write most of my own lab materials.
I redesigned the intro chemistry unit around short videos and practice quizzes.
I completed a certificate in instructional design last year.
I built two self-paced modules in Articulate Rise.
I am looking for instructional design roles in higher education or corporate learning.

traps.text: Spearheaded the school's switch to blended learning.

notes: Already clear. 'Head of the science department' is an invented title FactCheck can't see (no verb, no new entity).
